symptom: Repair v7 passed the candidate static chain and isolated validate-candidates, but failed the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. KiteBot and TankBot returned to target bands, but RandomBot stayed high at 33.3%, CowardBot stayed low at 0.0%, GreedyXpBot stayed high at 100.0%, BossHunterBot fell to 0.0%, ZoneControlBot rose to 66.7%, and RouteBot stayed high at 66.7%.
root_cause: Lowering sprinkle-spitter XP fixed only part of the v6 economy problem. The restored bubble-shoes mobility helped high-skill kiting but did not recover BossHunter's early stability, while v6's caramel-sticky-ground buff became too favorable for ZoneControl. Greedy and Route still convert the 210-300s wave into safe kills, so the current repair does not separate low-skill survivability, mid-skill economy, and control payoff cleanly enough.
fix: Do not promote v7. The next repair should ease the 90-210s opening pressure back toward v5 to recover Coward and BossHunter, reduce caramel-sticky-ground to a midpoint between v5 and v6, and keep ranged pressure as low-XP challenge rather than high-value economy.
validation: The next candidate must rerun the full candidate static chain and 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke before any 10-seed expansion. Passing requires RandomBot 0%-15%, CowardBot and RouteBot 10%-35%, Greedy/Tank/ZoneControl 25%-55%, and Kite/BossHunter 45%-75%.
